description: This is a PHP source file defining the Debug class within the Opencart 0r.admin 0r.controller 0r.event namespace. The class extends a system Controller and provides methods to hook into the 'before' and 'after' stages of route execution, primarily for debugging and logging purposes.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A controller class for debugging purposes, hooking into route execution to log debug information and timings.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Method executed before a route runs; can be used to set up debugging or monitoring for specific routes, e.g., 'common/home'.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Method executed after a route runs; logs execution time for specific routes, such as 'common/home', if debugging data is set in the session.
